lead_raw_text:
The structure of Nd8In4Rh4 (reduced formula Nd2InRh) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements: each In and Rh center has 12 Nd neighbors, while each Nd center has 4 In and 8 Nd neighbors, with neighbor distances near 3.50–3.54 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing among Nd-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, corner and face sharing between In- and Rh-centered polyhedra, and edge sharing between In- and Rh-centered polyhedra.
